issues.t: Rear suspension link bracket rusting off the frame (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the rear, the back end feeling loose or wandering, or the SUV pulling oddly when braking or going over bumps. Often there is no warning before a bracket lets go.
issues.why: Road salt eats away the frame bracket that holds the front end of each rear lower suspension link. Once it rots through, the link can pull away from the frame and the rear axle shifts. Isuzu recalled 2002 Axioms in 2010 (10V-436) and 2003-2004 Axioms registered in salt-belt states in 2013 (13V-547).
issues.next: Look under the rear of the SUV for heavy rust where the lower links meet the frame, or have a shop do it. If a bracket is cracked or loose, do not drive it. Isuzu's dealer network has shrunk, so call Isuzu customer service with your VIN to ask about any remaining recall help.

issues.sym: Flaking or holes in the frame rails, rusted-out brackets near the rear corners, a failed safety inspection, or a shop telling you the frame is unsafe even though the body looks fine.
issues.why: The Axiom's frame has thin rust protection. In states that salt their roads, frame rust is the most-reported problem with this SUV, and owners say the recall fix for the rear brackets did not stop rust elsewhere on the frame.
issues.next: Have the whole frame inspected on a lift, especially before buying one. Light surface rust can be cleaned and coated, but rot that goes through the metal usually makes the vehicle unsafe and not worth repairing.

issues.sym: Engine revs climb without the SUV speeding up, harsh downshifts, getting stuck in first or second gear, delayed engagement into Drive or Reverse, or red fluid dripping under the middle of the vehicle.
issues.why: The four-speed automatic wears out internally, often between about 60,000 and 140,000 miles. Some owners found metal debris clogging the filter. Several report that rebuilds did not last.
issues.next: Check the transmission fluid level and look for leaks. If it is slipping or won't upshift, drive gently and get a transmission diagnosis soon. Ask for a warranty on any rebuild, since repeat failures are common on this model.

issues.t: Fuel leak at the fuel pump, fire risk (recall)
issues.sym: Gasoline smell around the rear of the SUV, wet spots or drips near the fuel tank, or a check engine light from the evaporative system.
issues.why: Fuel contaminated with silicon could eat tiny pinholes in the fuel pump's feed port on top of the tank. Recall 05V-466 covered SUVs registered in Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, New Mexico and Louisiana. Owners elsewhere have also reported leaks from the top of the tank near the pump.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: if you smell burning or see smoke, pull over where it's safe, turn the engine off, get everyone out and well away from the car, and call 911 if there are flames. Don't drive it again until it has been repaired. If you smell fuel, park outside away from anything that can ignite it and don't drive until it's checked. Call Isuzu customer service with your VIN to ask if the recall applies.

issues.t: Sudden stalling or loss of power while driving
issues.sym: The engine cuts out at speed or when pulling into traffic, sometimes with the steering turning heavy. It may restart and run normally afterward. Some owners notice a fuel smell or a check engine light first.
issues.why: Owners trace it to several causes: a failing fuel pump, a bad throttle position or crank sensor, or an engine computer fault. Dealers often could not make it happen during a test drive.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: turn on your hazard lights, hold the wheel firmly and steer to a safe spot off the road. Steering and brakes can feel much heavier when the engine or power cuts out, so press the brake harder than normal. Have it checked before you drive it again. Steering and brakes get much heavier with the engine off. Have the stored codes read and fuel pressure tested soon. A stall in traffic is a crash risk, so don't put it off.

issues.t: Direct-injection fuel injector failure or clogging
issues.sym: Rough idle, misfires, a flashing or steady check engine light, hesitation, or stalling.
issues.why: The 2004 Axiom has an early direct-injection V6 that sprays fuel straight into each cylinder at high pressure. Isuzu issued a bulletin (05-02-001) with a special injector cleaning procedure for this engine, and owners report injectors failing. A leaking injector can wash fuel into the oil.
issues.next: Get the misfire codes read and ask the shop to check the injectors and fuel pressure. If the check engine light flashes, pull over when it's safe and turn the engine off.

issues.t: Engine jumps timing and bends valves
issues.sym: Misfire codes and a rough engine, then the engine quits and won't run properly again. Sometimes there is a loud knock first.
issues.why: Owners and shops have reported the camshaft sprocket or phaser slipping, and in one case a sheared crankshaft bolt. Either lets the valves hit the pistons and bend.
issues.next: If the engine suddenly runs very badly or quits, don't keep cranking it. Have it towed and ask for a compression or leak-down test before deciding whether a cylinder head repair or a replacement engine makes sense.

issues.t: Engine computer fault (P0602) shuts the engine down
issues.sym: Several warning lights come on at once, power drops sharply, and the SUV may stop in the road. A scan shows code P0602.
issues.why: P0602 means the engine computer has found a programming or internal fault. Owners of 2004 Axioms report this happening with no earlier warning signs.
issues.next: Get off the road safely. Have the code confirmed and ask the shop to check the computer's power and ground connections before replacing it. A replacement computer must be programmed for your VIN and immobilizer.

issues.t: Brake vibration and repeated rotor replacement
issues.sym: Shaking through the pedal and steering wheel when stopping, grinding or rattling noises, and stops that feel longer than they should. The problem tends to come back after new rotors.
issues.why: Isuzu issued a service bulletin (07-09-002) about the rear brake rotors. Owners report rotors warping and being replaced several times, sometimes with dealers unable to find a cause.
issues.next: Have the brakes inspected, including the rear rotors and calipers. If stops are getting longer or the pedal pulses hard, get it in soon and leave extra stopping room until then.

issues.t: ABS light on or brakes grabbing on slick roads
issues.sym: The ABS warning light stays on, or the brakes lock, pulse or slide unexpectedly on wet or snowy roads.
issues.why: Owners report ABS faults that can come from a failing wheel speed sensor, corroded wiring or the ABS control module.
issues.next: Have the ABS codes read. Normal braking usually still works with the ABS light on, but the wheels can lock in a hard stop, so drive with extra care until it is fixed.

issues.sym: A shake through the seat, floor or steering wheel that shows up around highway speed and may come and go.
issues.why: Uneven tire pressures, out-of-round tires or wheel balance are the usual causes. Some 2002 owners also needed driveshaft work before the vibration stopped.
issues.next: Start with tire pressures, a balance and a tire inspection. If it continues, have the driveshafts, U-joints and axles checked.

issues.sym: A chattering, shuddering or groaning from the rear during tight, slow turns such as parking-lot maneuvers.
issues.why: The limited-slip rear differential needs a friction additive in its oil. As that fluid breaks down, the clutches inside grab and release instead of slipping smoothly.
issues.next: Have the rear differential oil changed with the correct limited-slip fluid or additive. That usually fixes it.

issues.t: Shifter hard to move out of Park
issues.sym: The shift lever won't come out of Park, or takes a lot of force, even with the brake pressed.
issues.why: The shift lock solenoid or brake switch that releases the lever can stick or fail. Isuzu issued a bulletin (05-05-004) on replacing the shift lock solenoid.
issues.next: Check that the brake lights work, since the same switch controls both. Most shifters have a manual release slot near the lever for emergencies. Have the solenoid and switch tested.

issues.t: Oil leaks and high oil use
issues.sym: A burning-oil smell, oil spots under the SUV, or needing to add a quart or more between oil changes. In bad cases the engine knocks or stalls.
issues.why: Owners report gaskets leaking oil onto hot engine parts and engines burning oil with no visible leak. Running the engine low on oil can wreck it.
issues.next: Check the oil level every fill-up and keep it topped up. Have a shop find where any leak is coming from. If the engine knocks, stop driving it.

issues.t: Clacking noise for a few minutes after a cold start
issues.sym: A clacking, ticking or pinging sound for about three to four minutes after starting cold. It goes away once the engine warms up.
issues.why: Owners of 2004 models report this noise. Dealers called it normal for the engine, but it can also be a sign of low oil or worn valvetrain parts.
issues.next: Make sure the oil is full and the correct grade. If the noise gets louder, lasts longer or comes with a warning light, have a mechanic listen to it.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may not inflate properly (recall)
issues.sym: Usually none. You may not notice anything until a crash.
issues.why: A small number of passenger airbag modules were built without a check valve pin, so the airbag might not inflate fully. Recall 02V-213 covered the affected vehicles.
issues.next: Ask Isuzu customer service with your VIN whether the passenger airbag was replaced under the recall. If the airbag light is on, have the system checked before carrying a front passenger.

issues.t: Roof padding upgrade for head protection (recall)
issues.sym: No symptoms. The issue is how well the roof area protects front-seat heads in a crash.
issues.why: Federal head-impact testing showed a higher risk of head injury, so Isuzu added energy-absorbing parts to the roof area under recall 03V-113.
issues.next: Ask Isuzu customer service with your VIN whether the roof modification was done. It was a free repair.
